sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Muskegon State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483548: /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for the Channel Campground First Loop and Second Loop maps, 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13; read 2026-10-25)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site: $48 a night for the 108 20/30-amp sites, $53 for the 31 second-loop sites with 50-amp service (2027-05-18 and 07-13 alike). 2026: $45 / $50 (DNR rates table). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Channel Campground First and Second Loop sites: fee schedule -32687 feeTotal $48 and fee schedule -32688 (the 50-amp sites) $53 for 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Muskegon, Channel Campground: Modern camping 50 AMP rate $50, 20/30 AMP rate $45), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (all 139 Channel Campground campsites: 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup=No'; 31 Second Loop sites list 'Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps/50 Amps', the rest 20/30 or 30 amps) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/muskegon (Channel Campground tags 'Electrical service', 'Some campsites with 50-amp service'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 139 campsites: 93 in the first loop (sites 1-92, beside the navigation channel) and 46 in the second (101-147, larger sites near the dune and Muskegon Lake), every one with electric. Allowed rigs run up to 20-50 ft: the first loop is mostly 30-ft sites (67), the second mostly 45-50 ft; 33 sites take 50 ft. Ten pull-throughs (first loop 5, 8, 9, 18, 48, 53; second loop 131, 144, 146, 147).

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/muskegon (Muskegon Channel Campground: 'Number of sites: 139'; 'The first loop sites (#1-92) are adjacent to the navigation channel, and the second loop sites (#101-147) are located near the large dune and Muskegon Lake. The second loop features larger sites.'; tag 'Pull-through sites available') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (maps 'Channel Campground First Loop' 93 and 'Channel Campground Second Loop' 46 campsites; per-site allowed equipment up to 'Trailer or RV up to 50''; 'Pull Through=Yes' on 10 sites), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Toilet/shower building open for the whole reservation season (DNR rates table). A two-lane sanitation station with potable water is near both campgrounds.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/muskegon (Channel Campground tags 'Toilet & shower building', 'Sanitation station', 'Vault toilet'; 'A sanitation station is located near both campgrounds. There is potable water available and two lanes.') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Channel Campground: modern toilet/shower building 'Available for all reservable season'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/muskegon (Muskegon Channel Campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (139 bookable Channel campsites) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Muskegon, Channel Campground: reservation season starts April 22, ends October 21), read 2026-10-25

note: Modern campground in two loops by the Muskegon Lake navigation channel walkway: the first loop (sites 1-92) is adjacent to the channel, the second (sites 101-147) has larger sites near the big dune and Muskegon Lake. The channel walkway and its parking lot are closed for a U.S. Army Corps of Engineers project through Nov. 14, 2026 (DNR park page, read 2026-10-25). --Claude
summary: Verified at its own pin (the Channel Campground, separate from 3633): DNR park page + booking site + DNR rates table. 139 sites (confirmed), all electric, 50-amp at 31 (new), water false (confirmed) / sewer false (new), rigs to 50 ft, 10 pull-throughs (new), toilet/shower building + sanitation station (dump confirmed; showers/flush new), reservable on MiDNRReservations (confirmed), reservation season Apr 22 - Oct 21 (booking.season confirmed, derived -> manual). Fees 45-50 -> 48-53 (2027 booking site; 2026 $45/$50). No page states the campground's operating season, so season left absent. Phone 231-744-3480 matches. Note trimmed of field restatements; the channel-walkway closure added with its date.
